ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Moon and Venus at {H:1821970637000}

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, family and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, money and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.
